    ``````markdown
    ## Reason for This Test
    The level-2 workflow on the failing branch must reach a failed terminal state because its grandchild workflow failed and rolled up to it.

    ## Verification Steps

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",

    }
    ``````
